title: Unit
description: content/<lang>/units/<level>/<nn>-<slug>/unit.json. A themed group of 6 to 10 lessons that ends with a production lesson and a review lesson.

key.description: <lang>:unit:<level>-<nn>-<slug>. Must equal the directory name after the level.

ordinal.description: Position within the level. Must equal <nn> in the directory name.

theme.description: Goethe topic area, for example personal identification, home, daily life, free time, travel.

lessons.description: Lesson files in order. Every lesson-NN.json in the directory must be listed.
